From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Hart <michael.hart@orionthera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security recap & next steps (Type II report + portal access)

Hi Michael — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the evaluation side: 

Call recap:
- Primary concern: HIPAA coverage and data residency for PHI ingestion during inference.
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), bridge letter if full report can't be shared immediately, BAA question, and a vendor security questionnaire (DDQ) from your security team.
- Operational: preferred cloud region, logging/retention expectations, and whether you need a private deployment (VPC) for the PoC.

Proposed next steps (we can adjust):
1) I will initiate trust portal access and invite your security lead so you can retrieve our SOC 2 artifacts and bridge letter. Expect invite within 24 hours.
2) Please share your vendor DDQ (we can take the XLS or a DocuSign/Google Sheet). If easier, upload to the portal once invited.
3) We can provide a bridge letter referencing our most recent Type II cycle quickly (48 hours typical), and provide the full report under an NDA if required.
4) Ben (cc'd) will coordinate procurement/PO/BAA questions with you.

A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope evidence correctly:
- Do you require a signed BAA before access to the portal/artifacts?
- Preferred AWS region for the PoC (us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1)?
- Point of contact for procurement (name + email) so Ben can loop in pricing/terms.

Attachments I will include with the portal invite:
- Bridge_Letter_Redwood_Interim.pdf (interim bridge letter template)
- TrustPortal_Onboarding_Guide.pdf (short how-to for uploading a completed DDQ)

If you want a shorter call to walk your security team through the portal and artifacts, happy to set 30 minutes this week.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — good recap. A few quick notes from Orion's side: 

- We are HIPAA covered and will need confirmation that Redwood will sign a BAA; if you have a standard BAA we can start there.
- We would prefer us-east-1 for the PoC.
- I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Orion_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx) — please let me know if you prefer us to upload to your portal instead.
- If a bridge letter is available while the full Type II distribution is managed, that would be helpful for our procurement. Our compliance deadline for kickoff is May 15, 2028.

Appreciate the portal invite; I am adding Anna (security lead) to this thread so she can coordinate evidence review.

Michael — thanks, and hi Anna.

On the items you raised:
- BAA: Redwood has a standard BAA; I will ask our legal team to share a draft and Ben will include the reference in the procurement thread. If you'd like us to start with a redline, tell us which contacts to use.
- Region: us-east-1 noted for the PoC.
- DDQ: we can accept the attached XLS — if you prefer to upload the completed XLS to the trust portal that's great. I will send the portal invite to the three of you (michael.hart, anna.li, security@orionthera.com) within 24 hours.

Timing expectations from our side:
- Trust portal invite: within 24 hours. Portal will contain our latest SOC 2 Type II summary, the interim bridge letter, and a short onboarding guide.
- Bridge letter (customized to reference Orion): we can draft and deliver within ~48 hours after access is confirmed.
- Full SOC 2 Type II report: we maintain a rolling Type II attestation; if a formal distribution is required we can do that under an NDA and compliance checklist, estimated delivery 1–2 weeks depending on legal approvals.

I've attached the bridge letter template and the portal guide for your review. If Anna would like a walkthrough, Jonas (cc) can run a 30-minute session; Jonas will follow up separately with available times.

Thanks,
Naomi

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_Interim.pdf, TrustPortal_Onboarding_Guide.pdf
